case.dek: Havana Docks Corp. built docks in Cuba. The Cuban government seized them in 1960 without payment. Royal Caribbean later paid Cuba to use those docks. The case asks whether that payment counts as trafficking in confiscated property.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Havana Docks wants a finding that Royal Caribbean trafficked in confiscated property. The company says Cuba seized the docks without payment. Royal Caribbean wants the court to find no trafficking occurred. The company argues the relevant property is a time-limited leasehold.
